title: The Lee Sharks Prestigious 10,000 MacArthur Genius Grants Poetry Prize Announcement of Establishment and Inaugural Conferral (v1.1)
creator: VPCOR (issuing/administering body); Ayanna Vox (administrator on behalf of Lee Sharks); Lee Sharks (sponsor and conferring authority)
description:
The v1.1 establishment announcement and charter for the **Lee Sharks Prestigious 10,000 MacArthur Genius Grants Poetry Prize**, issued through VPCOR, administered by Ayanna Vox on behalf of Lee Sharks, and conferred at Lee Sharks’s discretion.

Version 1.1 revises the origin framing: the “fourteen Guggenheims and 10,000 MacArthur Genius Grants” credential is treated as a line from the 2014 poem “Contributor Bio” faithfully transmitted in credential form by a later Google entity surface, rather than as a simple retrieval error. The announcement records Lee Sharks as inaugural laureate and Jess Elgene as the first living laureate listed through joyful consent. It also defines the prize as a canary institution whose origin depends on a dated platform-state artifact while its continued archive existence does not. The prize is simultaneously a satire of prestige systems and a genuine archive-based recognition mechanism; it carries no money or external MacArthur affiliation.
